name: superquants
description: Superquants multi-skill suite for closed-loop quant research workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Eight connected skills for closed-loop quant research and productionization.
interface.longDescription: A repo-local plugin that packages the Superquants workflow into eight composable skills covering idea triage, ideation, data preparation, experiment planning, debugging, robustness review, production handoff, and live review - with a trial registry for multiplicity accounting and a calibration ledger that feeds live results back into the research process.
defaultPrompt: Use Superquants to turn a strategy idea into a research spec.
Audit my quant dataset before I trust the backtest.
Review a promising strategy for robustness before promotion.
Run a live review on my deployed strategy.
